result.title: Feedback That Backfires in Games: Do LLM Players Repeat the Move They Just Watched Fail?
result.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures. Code, probe items and raw records: https://github.com/Esmail-ibraheem/feedback-that-backfires/tree/games
result.summary: When an LLM agent's move fails, the harness writes the move and the failure message into the transcript and asks again. In tool calling, this record makes small models more likely to repeat the failed action. We test whether the same holds in games (Sokoban, Connect Four, Othello), where a move can fail by being illegal or by being legal but losing, both verified exactly. On fixed probe items built by perturbing a correct move, the record backfires: pooled over 8 instruction-tuned models (135M-1.7B) it makes the failed move more likely (corrective gain G = -1.38 nats per token), through the move's surface form, for illegal moves but not for losing ones, and not for every model. An exploratory analysis shows what sets the sign: after the record, the failed move's log-probability barely depends on how likely it was before (slope 0.18). Moves the model would not have played become more likely, and greedy decoding starts to produce them; moves it was about to play become less likely, but greedy decoding still repeats 38% of them. A description of the failure that omits the move string keeps the model's preference instead. Along the OLMo 2 1B post-training ladder the inversion is present in the base model and largely removed at the DPO stage. RAGEN's default models invert in RAGEN's own Sokoban format before any RL. A "do not repeat" instruction does nothing, a clean retry is the worst harness, and a decoder ban stops exact repeats but not illegal play. All measurements ran in float32 on a free Colab GPU, which first reproduced the original paper's number.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 LLM 游戏代理在失败动作被写入对话记录后是否更易重复该动作，在 Sokoban、四子棋和黑白棋上以扰动探针和 8 个指令微调模型测量纠正增益，并区分非法与合法但致败的动作。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“失败记录通过表面形式影响决策、省略动作字符串的描述则保留原偏好”的探针与对照，可供核查上下文证据的表征方式如何影响后续状态和答案贡献，与 LVR 中证据是否真正进入推理状态有间接联系。
